notes.title: Update 0.094 – Farming & AI Improvements
notes.content:
Fixes:


- Carts and rafts no longer disappear when exiting the game

- Allied settlers from other villages are no longer counted in the player’s population

- Visual fix for arrow shadows

- Bush and stone shadows now disappear after destruction

- Settlers returning to the village at night no longer forget their tasks

- Fixed a bug preventing settlers from building constructions

- Village menu no longer overlaps with other UI elements


Changes:


- Increased intelligence and improved behavior of all animals

- Some animals have been leveled up

- Animals no longer flee if surrounded or unable to escape – they will fight back

- Mammoths now have 20% more vision range

- Mammoth knockdown now triggers an area attack

- Mammoth's area attack deals 2x more damage

- Improved bear visuals

- Animals become aggressive when attacked (excluding passive animals)

- Bears now pounce on their target instead of charging

- Animals no longer spawn near buildings

- Settler names are now shorter

- Wooden arrows no longer cause bleeding

- Village food now includes vegetables and fish, not just meat

- To add a resource to the village, it must be moved from the storage chest and processed at a specific station

- Enemy levels in villages now scale with their size

- Improved hunter AI to gather food more efficiently

- Adjusted collision of some huts – more space inside

- During furniture placement, building collision is now highlighted

- Improved gamepad area management


New content:


- New Fisher’s Station: converts caught fish into village food (more features coming)

- Snowfall and low temperatures destroy crops

- Snow effect appears on soil in every biome; melts as temperature rises

- Melting snow irrigates farmland

- Wells irrigate nearby soil and speed up plant growth

- Rain also irrigates all soil

- New management tab in village menu: allows transferring resources from village to main chest (villager management coming soon)

- Bushes lose fruit, vegetables are destroyed

- Plants freeze when covered by snow or if temperature is below 0°C


Farming:




- New area: Farm

- New station: Farmer

- Assigned settler collects crops, mushrooms, raspberries and berries

- If a farm area is nearby, they till soil and plant the selected crop

- Once the plant is fully grown, they harvest and deliver it to the station, increasing food supply

- Farmers don’t farm during winter but can still harvest crops that survived frost


Other:


- Numerous small fixes

- Engine optimizations


Upcoming:


- Priority: bug fixes

- Focus on neutral and enemy villages

- Expansion of enemy settlements and new ones appearing

- Improvements to migration between villages

- Village list and settlement management UI

- New animals

- New side quests and tutorial improvements

- New random events



Thank you for your continued support and feedback.

This update lays the foundation for deeper settlement management and farming mechanics. More improvements and fixes are on the way. Stay tuned!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.093 – Fixes, Balancing and Fishing
notes.content:
Fixes


- Attacks no longer cancel the sleeping animation

- Cursor position fixed when using a gamepad on lower resolutions

- Settler count in statistics now calculates correctly

- Available settlement slots are now properly calculated

- Death count now saves correctly

- Selecting a resource with a gamepad no longer picks up the wrong item

- Thrown weapons now properly collide with mountains

- Hitting the training dummy no longer affects nearby workstations


Changes


- Further balancing of settlement growth

- Sleeping now requires holding the sleep button for a moment

- Mammoths now appear only in Snowy Tundras

- Reduced EXP gain from scorpions and turtles

- Woodcutters, miners, and hunters won’t collect resources without a nearby storage chest


Added


- Resources dropped by the player won’t be picked up by settlers for 5 minutes (unless directly ordered to do so)

- Option to rebind key controls in settings


New Feature – Fishing


- New item: Fish

- You can now catch fish with a bow (more methods coming soon)

- Fish can be cooked and eaten like meat


Next update plan


- Priority: fix all reported or noticed bugs

- Fishing spots for spear fishing

- Fisherman workstation

- Farmer workstation

- Settlers being able to fish and grow crops

- AI improvements for settlers

- Ongoing gameplay balance – all feedback helps


More details once these are done – likely next weekThanks for all your support and feedback!

notes.title: Small Patch 0.0921 – Gamepad Fixes, UI Tweaks & QoL
notes.content:
Fixes:
- Improved gamepad control during settler dialogues
- Fixed attack input when using a gamepad
- Training dummy now correctly reacts to spear attacks
- Training dummy now reacts to arrows
- Fixed a bug preventing ability purchases
- Resource list and group settler UI no longer overlap
- Fixed a bug where clicking LMB during skinning would reset the process and drain stamina

Changes:
- Settlement satisfaction now decreases only when recruiting new settlers is possible
- You can now assign a selected settler from group directly to a workstation
- Improved raft pushing and pulling mechanics
- Weapons can now be picked up even while carrying other items

Additions:
- Added a notification for input method changes
- Added gamepad cursor control in menus
- New icon showing the player's current carry weight

Plus various small improvements and tweaks to make things feel smoother.

Thanks for the feedback and keep it coming!

notes.title: Update v0.092 - Gamepad Support + Improvements
notes.content:
Gamepad Support + Fixes Update

Fixes
• Building plans are now always visible
• The building interface becomes semi-transparent when trying to place something over it
• You can now build structures even with the cursor on the building UI
• Building plans can no longer be placed too close to existing structures

Changes
• Character movement is now more responsive
• Lighting adjustments: the moon now brightens nights more noticeably, and sunrise/sunset lighting fades into reddish tones
• Throwing is now more precise, with an improved visual effect
• The cost of recruiting a settler now scales with the population size
• Beds have smaller hitboxes, making them easier to place inside shelters
• Animal corpses decay more slowly
• Required fatigue for sleep increased from 80% to 90%

Additions
• Dodging and swimming now reduce the duration of the burning effect
• Meat acts as bait – it attracts wild animals when left on the ground
• Gamepad support has been added (still in need of refinement)
→ Make sure to disable Steam Input in the game's controller settings on Steam for it to work properly

Final note
I’m constantly reading your suggestions, bug reports, and feedback – thanks for every comment that helps improve the game!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.091 - Fixes, Improvements, and New Features
notes.content:
Thanks to your reports and suggestions, we've introduced another batch of fixes, improvements, and a few new features. Here's what has changed:

Fixes:

- Fixed a visual bug when swapping weapons with a settler
- Fixed a death animation issue when enemies died while running
- UI for the whetstone and tanner no longer overlaps with other menus
- Fixed a rare issue where animals wouldn't react to the player
- Extra inventory pockets now save correctly
- Fixed a bug causing settlers to leave the village too frequently due to low satisfaction

Balance and Quality-of-Life Changes:

- You no longer need to unequip weapons to pick up resources
- Tracks of dead animals are no longer highlighted
- Settlement satisfaction growth has been rebalanced
- Resource gain from workstations now only occurs if a settler is assigned to them
- Improved tutorial texts for better clarity

New Features:

- Visual effect added when using the whetstone
- Fullscreen button added to graphics settings (previously only available via F11)
- Items taken from storage while using the cart now go directly into it
- New animation for carrying resources
- You can now assign idle settlers to workstations in the village
- Control scheme overview added to the menu
- Full translation of tutorial voice lines into all available languages

Several minor fixes have also been made in the background.
Full controller support is coming soon – a highly requested feature.
We're planning to release weekly updates with small fixes and additions, or larger updates less frequently, to keep development moving forward dynamically.

Thank you for all the reports and ideas – they’re a big help in improving the game.
If you spot a bug or have a suggestion, feel free to reach out on Discord or via the Steam community.

Thank you for your support and for being part of Primage’s journey.
